steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 20-second launch video for [your app], vertical 9:16 at 1080x1920, 30 fps, with every word inside the TikTok, Reels and Shorts safe zone.

Before you design anything, learn the app: read its store listing and website, and the codebase if you have it. Write down in one line what it does and who it is for, list its three strongest features, and show me that summary first.

Story:
1. Hook: the everyday moment the app fixes.
2. The app in a real phone frame, on its real screens, with taps marked.
3. Three features, one beat each, each with one short caption.
4. End card: icon, name, one-line promise and a store badge.

Look and motion: modern SaaS launch style, like the best YC launch videos: a clean canvas, the product's own accent colour, crisp kinetic type, springy UI transitions and quick zooms into the interface.

Sound: compose a short original track in code, or use a royalty-free one and tell me where it is from. Give every cut and reveal its own sound effect, land the cuts on the beat, and mix so nothing clips.

How to build it: draw every frame in code as a pure function of time (HTML, Canvas or SVG, Remotion or HyperFrames all work), render the frames headlessly and assemble an MP4 with the audio. Then watch your render at full speed and fix anything that feels slow, cramped, generic or off-brand before you hand it over.
